answer: Domain anchoring: each agent ID must publish a signed DNS TXT record on its own registered domain that is at least 180 days old, and the ledger pays only one ID per registrable domain. Like a ship that needs its own harbor, a clone can't share a port. Aged domains cost about $10/year and can't be minted on demand, so 100 fakes need $1,000 plus six months of planning, a frozen tundra of waiting before any reward summit. A domain caught signing for two IDs freezes both for 4 epochs.
